title: Primera visita 1: El mate tapado
caption:
Primera visita, episodio 1: el mate está tapado y todos te miran 🧉😰
¿Qué hacés? Comentá MUEVO o AVISO. El episodio 2 sigue a la mayoría 👇

vote.rule: episode 2 starts with the winner and its consequence

story.logline: On his first visit to his girlfriend's family, Tomás gets a clogged mate from her father, the proud cebador: sucking harder gives nothing, moving the bombilla is a sin in the ronda, telling him insults his mate; the family watches, the brother-in-law films, and the viewers decide.
timeline: One continuous moment, a Sunday about 16:00, sun; the whole episode lasts as long as the voice (no time jumps).
links: 1: the mate is already clogged when we start (the suegro just served it).
2: he tries the obvious fix first (suck harder) and fails.
3: the second fix would work but breaks a ronda rule; the suegro's face shows the price.
4: the third fix (tell him) has a price too: his pride as cebador.
5: the family waits, the clock runs: the pressure for the viewer.
6: freeze on the open choice; the vote decides episode 2.
objects: mate: full, green, clogged, in Tomás' right hand the whole time; nobody touches the bombilla.
green termo: in the suegro's left hand the whole time.
phone: in Facu's right hand, filming from shot 1b on.
knowledge: Everybody at the table sees that the mate does not pull.
Nobody says it: that is the joke and the pressure.

places.patio: the family patio (3D world patio); seated: Tomás at the back facing the camera, Nélida to his right, Caro to his left, Facu at the left side; the suegro stands behind Tomás' right shoulder

cast.vos: Tomás, 25, short dark hair, light blue shirt, beige trousers
cast.suegro: Don Rubén, 58, black boina, moustache, dark red polo, grey trousers, green termo
cast.abuela: Nélida, 82, grey bun, round glasses, purple cardigan
cast.novia: Caro, 24, dark ponytail, yellow T-shirt, jeans
cast.cunado: Facu, 30, curly hair, green football shirt, phone

patio.desc: family patio: brick floor circle, grass, white back wall with bushes, lemon tree, parrilla with smoke, string lights, round table with white cloth, yerba pack and medialunas, four low chairs, the dog
patio.light: afternoon sun from the front left

segments.text: Episodio uno: primera vez en lo de tu novia, y el mate está tapado.

shots.direction:
## 1a — frame 0: the clogged mate and the man behind him
What the viewer must understand without sound, in the first half second: a young man sucks on a mate and nothing comes, and a big man with a moustache stands right behind him and watches. Problem and threat in one picture. The voice says "Episodio uno", so the picture must already be the story, not a title card.

Set: the family patio in the afternoon sun (about 16:00). Behind Tomás we see the brick floor circle, the edge of the round table with the white cloth in the lower frame, a medialuna plate out of focus, the green grass, the white back wall with bushes and the lemon tree on the right edge of the frame. The string lights hang above, not lit (daytime). The sun comes from the front left, so Tomás' face is lit on his right cheek (screen left) and the suegro behind him gets a hard rim on his boina.

Tomás sits on his low chair at the back of the table, facing the camera. Light blue shirt, beige trousers, short neat dark hair. In his right hand (screen left) the calabaza with the steel bombilla; the bombilla is in his mouth. Face "suck": eyes wide open, small pupils, brows high, lips pursed round, cheeks puffed and red. He holds still, only the cheeks shake a little. His left hand rests on his thigh.

Don Rubén stands behind Tomás' right shoulder (screen left, half a metre back): black boina, thick moustache, dark red polo, grey trousers, the green termo in his left hand at hip height. Face neutral, lids half down: he watches the bombilla. He does not move at all; that stillness is the threat.

Camera: in front of Tomás at face height, a little lower than his eyes, about 1.4 m away, framing both heads: Tomás in the lower middle, the suegro's head above and left. Very slow push-in (1.4 → 1.2 m). Sound: a long dry suck noise that gets nothing.

## 1b — the whole family stares
Reverse shot from behind and above Tomás' left shoulder: we see the table from his side, and all faces turned to him. Nélida (grey bun, round glasses, purple cardigan) on the right, chin on her hand, curious. Caro (dark ponytail, yellow T-shirt) on the left, a polite smile that freezes. Facu (curly hair, green football shirt) at the far left lifts his phone with his right hand at 30 % of the shot and points it at Tomás: a red REC light blinks on the back. Pancho, the dog in the front right corner, lifts his head at 50 %.

Tomás' back and the mate fill the lower left corner of the frame. Camera still, slight drift to the right. Sound: a single tick (a clock in the silence).

## 1c — his face, sweat
Close on Tomás' face from the front. Sweat drops start at 20 % and run down from his temple. His eyes go to the abuela (screen left, 25 %), to Caro (55 %), then up over his shoulder to the suegro (80 %). Face "worried": brows up in the middle, mouth wavy. The mate stays at his chin. Camera very slow push-in.

segments.text: Si chupás más fuerte, no sale nada.

shots.direction:
## 2a — "Si chupás más fuerte…"
The viewer must see the first option being tried: he sucks harder. The voice says "Si chupás más fuerte" and the picture does exactly that on the word "fuerte".

Same patio, same afternoon sun. Medium shot of Tomás from the front, a little to his right, so the suegro is out of frame for once: the threat is the empty bombilla now. Behind him the white wall, the bushes and the lemon tree, soft. The table edge and the cloth at the bottom.

Tomás: mate in the right hand at his mouth, bombilla between the lips. At the start he takes a breath (chest up), then on "fuerte" he bends forward about 15 degrees, cheeks puff up even more and go red, eyes bulge, brows jump to the top. Small shaking of the whole upper body (effort). The left hand grips his knee.

Camera: starts at 1.3 m and pushes in to 1.0 m on "fuerte"; a small camera shake for the effort. Sound: two suck noises, the second longer and higher, then nothing.

## 2b — "…no sale nada."
Nothing comes. He takes the bombilla out of his mouth and sits back, dizzy: crossed-out eyes become spirals ("dizzy" face), three small yellow stars circle above his head. The mate comes down to his chest, still in the right hand, still full and green (the clog stays: continuity for the next shots). His head wobbles once.

Camera from slightly more to the side (30 degrees), 1.5 m, at face height, still. Behind him now the suegro is back in the frame, out of focus, arms crossed around the termo. Sound: a little sparkle when the stars appear.

The gag: he sucks so hard he almost faints, for a mate that gives nothing.

segments.text: Pero si movés la bombilla, el suegro no te lo perdona.

shots.direction:
## 3a — "Pero si movés la bombilla…"
The second option: move the bombilla. Everyone in a ronda knows: you never touch the bombilla of someone else's mate; it is the cebador's work.

Extreme close on the mate in Tomás' right hand: the calabaza with its green yerba top and the steel bombilla, his ball hand around the body of the gourd. His left hand comes in slowly from the screen right edge, on "movés", and stops two fingers away from the bombilla. It shakes a little. The background is the white tablecloth and the brick floor, very soft.

Camera: at mate height, 0.7 m, still, the mate in the centre. Sound: a tick on "bombilla".

## 3b — the suegro's eyes
Push-in on Don Rubén's face, from his front, slightly below (low angle = power). His lids drop to half, the inner corners of the brows go down, the moustache goes straight: face "angry" at the start, "rage" from 60 % on. His head turns to Tomás' hand. The termo in his left hand, at hip height, does not move. Behind him the blue sky and the string lights.

Camera: 1.2 m → 0.8 m, slow, steady. Sound: a low buzz at 60 %.

## 3c — "…el suegro no te lo perdona."
Wide from the camera side of the table: the whole ronda. Nélida (right) brings both hands to her cheeks, face "shock", glasses flash. Facu (left) leans the phone closer, face "sly", then "laugh". Caro freezes, face "scared". Tomás pulls his left hand back to his knee at 50 % (he did not dare), face "worried". The dog's head is up.

Camera still, 3 m, at 1.6 m height. Sound: a whoosh as the hand pulls back.

segments.text: Y si le avisás, quedás como que su mate está mal cebado.

shots.direction:
## 4a — "Y si le avisás…"
The third option: tell the cebador. Over the suegro's shoulder: in the foreground the back of his boina and his red shoulder (screen left), in the middle Tomás looking up at him. Tomás turns his head to the suegro, lifts his left index finger (hand up to shoulder height), opens his mouth: face "surprised", as if he is about to say "disculpe…". The mate stays in his right hand.

Camera: behind the suegro, 1.6 m from Tomás, at Tomás' eye height. Still. Sound: a short pop on "avisás".

## 4b — "…quedás como que su mate está mal cebado."
Don Rubén, proud: he leans back a little (chest out), lifts the green termo to chest height, face "proud": lids half down, a smirk under the moustache. He is the cebador of the house; a bad mate would be an insult to him. Low angle from the front, 1.4 m; behind him the sky. He nods twice slowly.

## 4c — Caro shakes her head
Close on Caro from the front: she looks at Tomás and shakes her head small and fast (no, no, no), face "scared": brows up, eyes wide, mouth wavy. Her ponytail swings. Camera 1.1 m, still. Sound: a swish.

segments.text: Tenés tres segundos: tres, dos, uno.

shots.direction:
## 5a — "Tenés tres segundos"
High wide of the ronda from the camera side, slow push-in toward Tomás: everyone looks at him (Nélida, Caro, Facu with the phone, the suegro standing behind him). Nobody moves; only the lemon tree leaves and the smoke of the parrilla. Camera from 3.4 m to 2.4 m, height 2.4 m → 1.9 m. Sound: ticks.

## 5b — "tres"
Close on Tomás' face, sweat. A big number "3" punches in at the top of the frame in a dark-brown circle with a terracotta ring that runs out. Camera 1.0 m, the face in the lower half of the frame so the number never covers it. Sound: tick.

## 5c — "dos"
Close on the suegro's narrowing eyes, low angle; the number "2". Sound: tick.

## 5d — "uno"
Close on Facu's phone: the red REC light blinks, Facu's grin behind it; the number "1". Sound: tick.

segments.text: ¿Qué hacés? Comentá MUEVO o AVISO. El episodio dos sigue a la mayoría.

shots.direction:
## 6a — the freeze and the vote
On "¿Qué hacés?" the picture freezes on Tomás' face: a short white flash, then everything stands still (the sweat drops hang in the air). Face "scared": brows high, tiny pupils, mouth wavy; the clogged mate in his right hand at his chest; the suegro behind his shoulder, frozen too.

Under his face the two vote words punch in side by side: MUEVO (terracotta) o AVISO (cream). The face stays in the upper half; the words sit in the lower third, never over the face. They stay until the end while the voice says: "Comentá MUEVO o AVISO. El episodio dos sigue a la mayoría." Sound: a pop when the words appear.
